_comment: NEGATIVE-CONTROL OVERRIDE TABLE - example. Keys: require, fail_pattern,
expect_min. Unknown keys and unknown gate names are REFUSED (exit 2),
because an override that is silently ignored produces a green you will
read as a proven negative control.
Computed gates (judges) cannot be doctored here: nothing would consult
the override, so the runner refuses rather than pretending.
Any run that names this file exits 2 INSTRUMENTED and cannot certify.
Keep real negative-control files OUTSIDE the repo when you use them in
anger - this one is committed only as documentation of the shape.
